meta.name: May I Help You
meta.description:
Baek Dong Joo, a newly hired funeral director, has the uncanny gift, or curse, to momentarily resurrect and talk to the recently deceased. She has to grant their last wishes or have her days be filled with a series of bad luck and accidents. And helping the little boy that first terrified her when he came to life will lead her down a path she never could have expected.

Kim Tae Hee works as a man for hire. Employed by his uncle Vincent running the newly opened errand service company “A Dime A Job” he can be hired for any odd (but legal) task.  One day, Kim Tae Hee encounters Baek Dong Joo, when he is hired by her boyfriend to break up with her in his stead. After that, their paths continue to cross, and by the virtue of their jobs, their fates get intertwined deeper and deeper in a series of life and death situations, surrounding the wishes of the people who had died, and the painful past it is going to unravel for both of them.

Ended · First aired 19 Oct 2022 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 70 min
Studio: iWill Media · Network: MBC

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16

videos.title: I Do Anything for You
videos.overview: Baek Dong-joo, a funeral director meets Kim Jib-sa, an errand boy of the neighborhood. Dong-joo kicks Jib-sa in the shin and disappears all of a sudden after asking an odd job. What on earth is this woman?

videos.title: A Strange Woman
videos.overview: Dong-joo and Jib-sa meets again at a funeral. Jib-sa tries to run away but Dong-joo stops him. There is no sign of easing between them.

videos.title: Let Me Tell You a Secret
videos.overview: Why are you in the closet? Ildangbaek is now in a serious trouble because of Dong-joo. Jib-sa is not sure if he can trust her or stop her.

videos.title: The Guy I Already Knew
videos.overview: Jib-sa seriously misunderstands Dong-joo after he encountered an unexpectedness in the mortuary. Meanwhile, Dong-joo tries all possible means to grant the dead wish.

videos.title: Misunderstanding and Prejudice
videos.overview: It is one thing after another for Dong-joo to meet the dead clients. With her hands full, she was caught up with Jib-sa. Meanwhile, Tae-hee dwells on what Dong-joo said.

videos.title: The Way I Console You
videos.overview: "You must be so lonely." These were Taehee’s words to Dongju’s story and after sharing a secret, the two become closer.

videos.title: A Girl Showed Up
videos.overview: A girl shows up, her name is Chung-ha and she seems to have a long history with Tae-hee. Is she his first love?

videos.title: The Broken Promise
videos.overview: It seems not just first love - Tae-hee is reminded of the terrible day two years ago when he met Chung-ha. Dong-joo strugles with their relationship.

videos.title: The Letter That I Can't Send
videos.overview: Tae-hee shares the stories deep inside his heart with Dong-joo, but something remains unsettled between them.

videos.title: I Can See Your Lies
videos.overview: After Dong-joo's confession, Tae-hee, Chung-ha, and Dong-joo face a new chapter of their relationship. Meanwhile, a new guest visits Ildangbaek. This time, Dong-joo works with their new client.

videos.title: When the Fall Comes
videos.overview: With autumn, Dong-joo and Tae-hee relationship finally comes to fruition. The name of the chief mourner to a new death seems familiar.

videos.title: Meeting You
videos.overview: The boy was Tae-hee's brother? Dong-joo and Hae-an figure out who Jun-ho was. They face a dilemma of their own.
